text:
Arjun Patel: FYI saw canary failures immediately after the CI mirror push to eu-mirror. health checks 2/5 fails, startup logs show image digest mismatch and container OOM/EOF during pull. paging oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: service=embeddings-runner image=registry.redwood.io/embeddings:v20260315-rc3 -> mirror=eu0.mirror.redwood.io (3 replicas). status: 2/5 failing. logs uploaded to /var/logs/deploys/1777777777.log

Mia Chen: I'm oncall, grabbing logs. which registry did you push from? @Arjun Patel can you paste the failing container logs?

Arjun Patel: pasted snippet from node-7 startup: ```
time=\"2026-03-15T18:02:12Z\" level=error msg=\"pulling blob sha256:6a1f... failed: received unexpected EOF\"
time=\"2026-03-15T18:02:12Z\" level=error msg=\"blob not found: status=404, err=unknown blob\"```

Leo Park: seeing similar in mirror access logs: eu0.mirror returned 200 for the tag lookup but 404 when fetching blob by digest. upstream registry says blob present. looks like mirror served stale tag->digest mapping while primary had rotated that tag to a new digest.

SRE-Tilly: paging SRE. If the mirror is returning wrong blob digests for the tag, we should halt promotion immediately. Flip the auto-promote flag and stop rollouts. Mia, can you flip deploy_auto_promote off?

Mia Chen: flipping flag now -> deploy_auto_promote=false :white_check_mark: stopping any automatic promotions. Also kicking rollback to previous stable digest sha256:9f3c... initiating.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for embeddings-runner -> pinned digest registry.redwood.io/embeddings@sha256:9f3c... Rolling back canary set. Expected completion ~3m.

CI-Watcher: CI pipeline note: mirror sync job finished at 18:00:33 UTC. observed 5xx from origin during blob push window 18:00:30-18:00:40. It retried to mirror; mirrors have eventual consistency behind CDN.

Jess Gomez: quick summary from platform: our mirror rewriter rewrites tag->digest mappings to point to local mirror blobs. looks like one mirror got a partial push (manifest updated but blob push failed) and returned stale mapping to clients. That caused the node to try to fetch blob by digest and 404.

Arjun Patel: reproduced locally by forcing a mirror to return old manifest while blob absent. root cause: pipeline doesn't verify that all blobs are present on mirrors after push. we'll need a post-push verification step that pulls the image by digest from each mirror.

Leo Park: customer impact assessment: canary users hitting eu region saw 503s and container crashes for ~12m until rollback finished. No user data was modified. Error budget impact: ~0.6% increase in 5xx for embeddings-runner across eu. No API keys or secrets exposed.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-09 \"mirrored registry tag->digest mismatch caused canary failures\". Severity: P2. Pager escalations: eng-sre, eng-infra, platform.

Mia Chen: Notifying support and product: sending brief to #support-prod now. Recommend email hold until we confirm all artifacts healthy.

Jess Gomez: Mitigation complete: rollback finished at 18:10:20 UTC, canary healthy 5/5 on previous digest. Action items: 1) add post-push digest check (skopeo/dockerd inspect by digest) 2) pin pipeline to use digests in canary promotion 3) add alert for tag->digest mismatch (tag resolves to digest A but registry index returns digest B) 4) reduce mirror TTL and add retry/backoff on mirror sync. I'll open infra PRs.

Arjun Patel: I'll draft the pipeline PR: verify-by-digest step using `skopeo inspect docker://eu0.mirror.redwood.io/embeddings@sha256:${DIGEST}` and fail the job if blob not fetchable. Will also add a short wait+verify loop for mirrors.

Leo Park: handoff: I'm taking follow-up oncall for overnight. will validate mirror consistency across regions and monitor incident board. Mia, handing off slack.

Mia Chen: ack handoff. leaving notes in INC-20260315-09 and adding timeline. thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-09 updated: mitigated (rollback complete), next steps assigned to Platform/Jess, CI/Arjun.

CI-Watcher: Postmortem draft template created at https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260315-09/edit. Please add logs, timeline, and PR links.

Arjun Patel: PRs: pipeline verify (WIP) + mirror healthcheck (WIP). ETA EOD. Will include test that simulates manifest present/blob missing scenario.

SRE-Tilly: Thanks team. Once PRs land, let's try a dry-run mirror push to staging and run the verify step. Closing loop after postmortem.

Mia Chen: closing thread here, monitoring for any regression. if anyone sees re-occurrence ping me directly.

Leo Park: noted, watching metrics dashboard. :eyes:
